The report, henceforth referred to as the “Action 1.1.3 Report,” provides background on P3 definitions, and Federal and state statutory and regulatory authorities. It also explores the current applications of P3 to U.S. Arctic maritime infrastructure and provides examples of projects currently underway that use P3 or alternative financing mechanisms. As required, the report also applies potential P3 schema to address the recommendations made in the report under Action 1.1.2, “A Ten-Year Prioritization of Infrastructure Needs in the U.S. Arctic.” Finally, the report includes recommendations and conclusions.
